doc.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier and Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-01-18

title: Two-fold marches and dropping down to the chorus
summary: Cie asks how two-fold marches go. Williams plays snare and bass drum on a march (Maryland suggested), counts it and drops down to the chorus, then asks how to end it. Much of the text is garbled.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs
